meta.title: Robert Dachservice – Theme Test
meta.description: Test instance for the WordPress conversion on the wordpress-conversion branch.
meta.author: Robert Dachservice

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

$checks = [];
$checks['theme_active'] = wp_get_theme()->get('Name') === 'Robert Dachservice';
$checks['front_page_template'] = file_exists(get_template_directory() . '/front-page.php');
$checks['header'] = file_exists(get_template_directory() . '/header.php');
$checks['footer'] = file_exists(get_template_directory() . '/footer.php');
$checks['contact_template'] = file_exists(get_template_directory() . '/page-kontakt.php');
$checks['service_template'] = file_exists(get_template_directory() . '/page-leistung.php');
$checks['region_template'] = file_exists(get_template_directory() . '/page-region.php');
$checks['lead_cpt'] = post_type_exists('rd_lead');

foreach ($checks as $name => $ok) {
    echo ($ok ? 'PASS ' : 'FAIL ') . $name . PHP_EOL;
}

if (in_array(false, $checks, true)) {
    exit(1);
}
